summary: i3 Verticals, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that subsidiary i3 Verticals, LLC entered an Amended and Restated Credit Agreement on October 9, 2026, with guarantors, lenders, and JPMorgan Chase as administrative agent, replacing the prior May 8, 2023 credit agreement. The facility is a $350 million senior secured revolving credit facility, with an accordion up to the greater of $100 million or 100% of consolidated EBITDA plus certain prepayments, priced at base rate or Term SOFR plus a leverage-based margin. This is a routine refinancing, not a special situation; watch leverage covenants and borrowing costs.
